LESSON: PEACE AND NON-VIOLENT CONFLICT RESOLUTION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.5: Peace and Non-violent Conflict Resolution
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Peace and Non-violent Conflict Resolution, part of People and Relationships in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we promote peace in the community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain types of peace for sustainable social interactions,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Peace and Non-violent Conflict Resolution in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. identify barriers to conflict resolution in day-to-day lives,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Peace and Non-violent Conflict Resolution in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. explore ways of managing emotions in promotion of peace in the community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Peace and Non-violent Conflict Resolution in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. apply emotional intelligence for peaceful conflict resolutions in the community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Peace and Non-violent Conflict Resolution in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. embrace peace initiatives and agreements at the community level for harmonious living. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Peace and Non-violent Conflict Resolution together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: Learners search and explore different options as they compose songs or poems on non-violent

conflict resolution in the community.

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Learners discuss possible solutions of managing emotions to promote peace in the

community.

Values:
• Peace: Learners display calmness as they discuss ways of managing emotions to promote peace in the community.

• Integrity: Learners exhibit fairness as they role play activities on cultivating peace initiatives and agreements at the

community level for harmonious living.

24

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social cohesion: Learners work together and discuss resolutions to conflicts in the community.

• Self Esteem: Learners compose songs or poems on non - violent conflict resolution in the community.

Link to other learning areas:

• Learners use Creative Arts skills to compose songs or poems on non-violent conflict resolution in the community.

• Learners apply Religious Studies knowledge to role play activities on cultivating peace initiatives and agreements at the

community level for harmonious living.
